intent: Find a ticket by number and close it with the given resolution; when the resolution is 'duplicate', also comment which ticket it duplicates.
second_installation: signed in as 'triager', a non-admin role with TICKET_MODIFY only

verify_yaml.first:
schema_version: openadapt.verify/v1
app:
  name: Trac service desk (local test copy)
  url: http://127.0.0.1:9485/
  version: trac@1.6
  session: benchmark.onboarding_effort.hooks:open_session
  reset:
    python: benchmark.onboarding_effort.hooks:reset
verifier:
  kind: sql
  sqlite_database: /Users/abrichr/oa/scratch/onboarding-effort/trac-db/trac.db
  sql_query: "SELECT '#' || id AS ticket, status, resolution FROM ticket"
effects:
  - kind: field_equals
    match: {ticket: {param: ticket}}
    field: resolution
    value: {param: resolution}
  - kind: field_equals
    match: {ticket: {param: ticket}}
    field: status
    value: {literal: closed}
save_step: auto
inputs:
  source: recorded
campaign:
  id: onboarding-tr-ticket-resolve-first
  trials: 3
  policy: permissive
